explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/1129: Erdős [Er61c] proved Λ(x_1,…,x_n) > (2/π) log n − O(1) for all choices of nodes. The Lean statement: ∃ C, for all n ≥ 1 and all node sets x (strictly increasing, in [−1,1]), (2/π)·log n − C < lebesgueConstant x. Uniform constant, natural log, all n ≥ 1. Faithful.
